item.title: Anopyrin 100 mg tablets, 56 tablets
item.description: Anopyrin 100 mg is a low-dose acetylsalicylic acid medicine used to prevent blood clots in patients at risk of heart attack or stroke. It is used as add-on therapy in unstable angina, after a heart attack, after artery procedures, and to prevent transient ischaemic attacks. Active substance: acetylsalicylic acid 100 mg Form: tablet Pack size: 56 tablets How to use: Take one tablet daily after a meal, swallowed whole with plenty of water; do not take on an empty stomach. In acute heart attack, the first tablet should be chewed. Warnings: Not for pain relief. Avoid in active stomach ulcers, bleeding disorders, severe kidney, liver or heart failure, and in children under 18 with fever. Use caution with other blood-thinning medicines and before surgery or dental work. Read the patient information leaflet before use.
